entities.summary: Mikhail Valeryevich Pashnin is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently an unrestricted free agent. He most recently played for HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted in the 7th round of the 2009 NHL Entry Draft by the New York Rangers, and he was also the 1st overall pick in that year's KHL Junior Draft by CSKA Moscow.
